title: The Borrowed Glasshouse
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Casper Iversen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
